name: honest-learn
description: Vercel project root: the web app is built from app/, the API function lives in api/ (code in server/). See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.

scripts.dev: npm run setup && npm run build:web && npm run preview
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix app --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build:web: cd app && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=/api CI=1 npx expo export --platform web
